entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: A satyr planeswalker of the Skola Valley on Theros, epitome of satyr ideals of pleasure and revelry and de facto revelry host.

entities.name: The Satyrs of the Skola Valley
entities.description: Satyrs of Theros for whom pleasure, revelry and mischief are virtues of the highest regard.

events.summary: Xenagos's planeswalker spark ignites and he is excited to bring his hedonism to distant planes.
events.quote: When his Planeswalker spark ignited, he was excited to bring his boisterous, carefree hedonism to distant planes.

events.summary: Seeking all the pleasures of the Multiverse, Xenagos finds only disillusionment.
events.quote: but what he found instead was disillusionment.

relations.target: The Satyrs of the Skola Valley
relations.note: He does not rule them but savors his role as de facto revelry host.
relations.quote: While he does not rule the satyrs, Xenagos savors his role as de facto revelry host.
